description: Get a single calendar event by id. Requires calendar_id (sent as a query param). Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/events/{event_id}.

calendar_id.description: REQUIRED. The calendar id (sent as a query param).

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.
